problem: More Nigerians now use smartphones, WhatsApp, bank apps, POS machines, email and online markets than ever before. At the same time, scams and fraud have become common: fake bank SMS alerts, WhatsApp impersonation of family members, fake job and investment offers, and "your account is blocked" messages. Small businesses — a tailoring shop, a church, a small school, a market trader — often lose money and customer trust because nobody taught them basic safety.
